resources.string: CSV files are for spreadsheets and other systems. Use Backup in Settings to keep your logbook safe.
Writes flights, gliders and airfields as three CSV files.
The whole file is checked first and nothing is imported if any row has an error. Gliders and airfields that already exist are skipped, never updated.
Imported %1$d flights. New records: %2$d gliders, %3$d airfields, %4$d clubs.
There is no import to undo

Remove %1$d flights, %2$d gliders and %3$d airfields added by the import of %4$s on %5$s? Gliders and airfields still used by other flights stay. Flights from this import are removed even if you have edited them since.
Launch type for %1$d rows without one
The file has no log_no column. Flights will be numbered %1$d to %2$d in file order.
Pilot in command for %1$d PIC, Instructor and Coach rows without one
